mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high federal funds rates.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low unemployment rates.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong housing starts and low unemployment rates.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production indicates a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with low industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP indicate a growing economy with tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances with high federal funds rates and strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and a low unemployment rate indicate a strong consumer sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong retail sales and low unemployment rates.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in payroll employment indicates a slowing labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with low payroll employment.
